feature: Extract repeated gradient pattern into SCSS mixin
description: The gradient pattern 'linear-gradient(90deg, $primary-color 0%, $secondary-color 167%)' appears 16+ times across 10 SCSS files including hero.scss, button.scss, blog-card.scss, _header.scss, and _page-layout.scss with slight variations (107%, 167%).

phases.name: Create Brand Gradient Mixin
phases.description: Add the gradient mixin to the existing mixins file with configurable parameters

subtasks.title: Create brand-gradient mixin in _C_mixins.scss
subtasks.description: Add a new @mixin brand-gradient() with a $intensity parameter (default 167%, hover variant 107%) to component-library/shared/styles/0-settings/_C_mixins.scss. The mixin should output: background: linear-gradient(90deg, $primary-color 0%, $secondary-color $intensity);
